chapters.text: See each office on its own, and let branch staff see only their office's money.
On the dashboard or Boss view, click All offices / Head office / Bahadurabad.
To limit branch staff: in Money holders set the holder's Office to the branch name from Company & Branches.
In Access permissions → Finance → Read, choose “Their branch's items” for the branch role.
Give the user that branch in Settings → Users.
